text:
Ava: FYI saw spike of mTLS handshake failures in APAC after last night's cert rotator run. multiple services returning 502/handshake failed. digging in now.
Sanjay: on it. any service names or top-level logs?
Ava: edge-proxy, model-ingest-apac, auth-gateway. getting repeated: 
```
TLS handshake error: remote error: tls: bad certificate
service=auth-gateway host=auth-apac-1 region=apac-1
```
Leah: rotator-bot reported rotation complete for apac-edge at 00:12Z but with errors. @rotator-bot can you paste the error summary?
rotator-bot: rotation summary for apac-edge: status=partial, rotated=18/20, errors=2. error_type=KMS_DECRYPT_DENIED. affected=auth-gateway, model-ingest-apac.
Darya: that smells like RBAC or KMS IAM change. did we roll any vault/KMS policy changes around the same time?
Sanjay: yes; PR https://git.internal.redwood/infra/PR-1423 tightened kmsDecrypt for the rotator principal (scoped to eu and na). APAC was intentionally left out to limit blast radius but maybe the principal ARN changed.
Mike: confirming: earlier today ops applied the new IAM binding, which removed the legacy "rotator-service-legacy" role in favor of "rotator-service-v2". apac still has legacy entries but the rotator pod identity now uses v2.
Ava: so rotator couldn't unwrap apac keys -> left a mixed certset. clients got new certs without proper private key unwrap. handshake fails.
Leah: can someone paste the rotator log showing KMS error?
Ava: log snippet: 
```
2026-03-23T00:12:14Z rotator[pid=42] WARN unwrap key failed: KMS AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:iam::123456:role/rotator-service-v2 is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:apac-1:123456:key/abcde-...
stack=rotator/unwrap.go:87
```
Darya: ok root cause confirmed. temporary fix: re-grant kms:Decrypt on apac key to rotator-service-v2 or rollback the IAM binding. which is faster?
Sanjay: fastest is to add a scoped statement to the apac KMS key policy granting `arn:aws:iam::123456:role/rotator-service-v2` decrypt for that key. I'll open a quick change.
Mike: +1. also need to reconcile why the identity switched to v2 during deploy. ops-runbooks: check serviceAccount->IRSA mapping.
Leah: action items: 
- Sanjay: apply KMS key policy patch to grant kms:Decrypt for rotator-service-v2 to apac keys (temp)
- Darya: coordinate an emergency rotator re-run after policy change to complete rotations
- Mike: audit the deploy that flipped identity and revert if misconfig applied
- Ava: open an incident page and capture impacted customers
Ava: starting incident: https://incidents.internal/redwood/INC-2026-03123 — adding links to logs.
rotator-bot: queued rotation retry for apac-edge after policy update. will report status.
Sanjay: applied KMS key policy patch at 00:26Z (change-id: kms-patch-884). snippet: 
```
KeyPolicy: 
  - Sid: AllowRotatorV2Decrypt
    Effect: Allow
    Principal: arn:aws:iam::123456:role/rotator-service-v2
    Action: kms:Decrypt
    Resource: "*"
    Condition: { "StringEquals": { "aws:RequestedRegion": "apac-1" } }
```
Ava: after patch I see rotator re-run logs showing unwrap success and certs marked rotated=20/20 for apac-edge.
rotator-bot: rotation retry result: apac-edge rotated=20/20 status=success.
Leah: can we validate end-to-end? any still failing services?
Ava: auth-gateway and model-ingest show successful handshakes now. latency normalizing. will keep monitoring for 1 hour.
Darya: follow-ups: 
- add an integration test in CI that verifies rotator principal mapping per region
- update PR-1423 to explicitly document which roles must be added to apac keys (and include a smoke test)
- run a short RBAC sweep to detect principals with region mismatches
Mike: also add audit logs alert: KMS Decrypt AccessDenied event -> create slack notification for sec-oncall and unblock play.
Sanjay: created follow-up task in infra board: INFRA-987 (add smoke test + docs).
Ava: thanks all. closing thread for now — will update incident page if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
